requirements.text: When lateral alignment error exceeds 5 mm during CHARGING_PREPARATION, the charging controller shall disable power-transfer authorization within 100 ms and shall keep authorization disabled until alignment state ALIGNED is received through ARCH-IF-006.
When an authenticated charging session is cancelled, the controller shall open the power contactor within 150 ms and record cancellation reason USER_REQUEST.
The system should quickly stop charging when alignment is not good.

candidate_artifacts.name: Charging authorization state guard
candidate_artifacts.text: The design blocks contactor authorization when lateral alignment error is above 5 mm and keeps the guard active until the AlignmentStatus value ALIGNED is consumed.

candidate_artifacts.name: Alignment contract boundary verification
candidate_artifacts.text: Verify that alignment errors of 5.1 mm block power transfer within 100 ms and that the interface consumer accepts only the ALIGNED enumeration.

candidate_artifacts.name: Authorization timeout unit boundary
candidate_artifacts.text: Exercise the charging authorization timer at 99 ms, 100 ms, and 101 ms after a misalignment event and verify the power authorization boolean.

candidate_artifacts.name: AlignmentStatus enumeration contract
candidate_artifacts.text: The producer and consumer exchange UNKNOWN, MISALIGNED, ALIGNING, and ALIGNED values through one versioned interface contract.

candidate_artifacts.name: Cabin ambient-light preference
candidate_artifacts.text: The cabin controller stores the driver's selected ambient-light color for the next authenticated journey.

candidate_artifacts.name: Infotainment language selection
candidate_artifacts.text: Verify that the infotainment display restores the previously selected language after a restart.

historical_defects.title: AlignmentStatus enumeration drift after interface upgrade
historical_defects.description: An integration test rejected VALID because the downstream charging state machine expected ALIGNED after a partial interface deployment.
symptoms: producer and consumer used different enumeration names
historical_defects.root_cause: Producer remained on interface v2.0 while the consumer used v2.1.
historical_defects.resolution: Baseline one generated interface package for both components and add a compatibility integration test.

historical_defects.title: Stale interface package deployed to HIL bench
historical_defects.description: A green component build failed on the integration bench because the bench image contained an older interface package.
symptoms: runtime contract version differed from build manifest
historical_defects.root_cause: The HIL deployment manifest referenced the previous configuration baseline.
historical_defects.resolution: Validate deployed package hashes against the approved baseline before test execution.

historical_defects.title: Charging state machine rejects alignment producer value
historical_defects.description: IT-045 fails when AlignmentController publishes VALID and ChargingStateMachine expects ALIGNED.
historical_defects.root_cause: The components were built against different controlled versions of ARCH-IF-006.
historical_defects.resolution: Deliver COMMIT-c821ac, rebuild both components against v2.1, and re-run IT-045.

historical_defects.title: Infotainment theme resets after profile switch
historical_defects.description: The display uses the default theme after switching driver profiles.
historical_defects.root_cause: The profile service did not persist the theme key.
historical_defects.resolution: Persist and reload the theme key with the driver profile.
